text: Completed exact-schedule scalar ILP and dispatch-once primitive mutable kernels. Raw-bit non-dyadic/tail laws preserve the fixed 128-value block order and merge tree on JVM and Scala.js; all seven primitive assign storages, negative strides, mutation locality, Float rounding, and Int/Long overflow are covered. JDK 21/25 controls show 1.52-1.99x full-sum and 1.79-2.34x axis-1 ILP speedups. The 18-row in-place NumPy geomean moved from 0.026x to 0.967x on JDK 21 and 0.027x to 0.990x on JDK 25; selected allocation is now roughly constant per operation rather than about 48 B/element. Reversed traversal remains a visible 0.43-0.52x loss. Gates: JDK 25 fmtCheck plus 126 JVM/126 JS/2+2 laws, JDK 21 focused 24 tests, Python 10 tests, and both JDK 21/25 32+158-row parity gates are green. Same-host receipts and caveats are checked in under the two 2026-07-28-local-*-stage2 directories; git diff --check and type-discipline review are clean.
